title: Novel eco-friendly antiscalant for major inorganic scaling control: laboratory tests and scale-up in a pilot RO unit
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00448A, Paper
Saad S. M. Hassan, Mohamed Sobhi, Belal N. Mahran
Synthesis, characterization, and performance assessment of a novel green antiscalant, PASP–SEA. Bench-scale and RO-pilot tests compared its efficiency with other green antiscalants. Results aid researchers and RO engineers in industrial applications.
